==Description==
'''D-5i''' is a faster and more aggressive version of [[D-5]]. Purple realistic eye, with teeth surrounded by it.

==Behavior==
'''D-5i''' spawns in front of the door and stays there. After approximately 2-4 seconds, it will start to quickly pass the rooms, rebounding and damaging anyone who gets in it's line of sight. However, if you still hide in any hiding spot when '''D-5i''' is far enough, you will also get damaged, although damage from this is less. It will occasionally fake it's despawn to trick players into thinking it's gone. While faking it's despawn, '''D-5i''' can still damage you. Damage that you take by '''D-5i''' is much greater than [[D-5]].

However, '''D-5i''' can spawn in a different way, that is upon blinding [[D-5]] multiple times, [[D-5]] will start to destroy the door after 2 seconds upon spawning. If the player continue to shoot [[D-5]] when he starts to destroy the door, '''D-5i''' will imitate it, by knocking in the door just like [[D-5]], but will give 1,5 seconds before destroying the door. Then '''D-5i''' will just act like normal, but will rebound much more times due to be generated by killing [[D-5]] multiple times.

If you shoot '''D-5i''' with a powerful weapon like ''R870 Express'' or ''APAR-16'', you can anger '''D-5i''', causing it to become <span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">Red</span>, meaning that it has become angered, which causes D-5i to become very fast, and it will rebound a lot and a lot.

==Strategy & Tips==
*'''D-5i''' ignores safe spots from close distance, so don't use safe spots when '''D-5i''' is active.
*'''D-5i''' deals much greater damage than [[D-5]], so before you meet '''D-5i''', collect as much healing items as you can.
*If [[D-140]], [[D-60i]] are active or [[D-60]] is rebounding while [[D-5]] is angered, stop shooting [[D-5]] because if '''D-5i''' spawn while one of them are active, the chances of surviving are very low.
*If '''D-5i''' spawns while [[D-140]] is active, you should go to the main room and try using safe spots while '''D-5i''' is far and pray that [[D-140]] arrives at the same time as '''D-5i''' does or that [[D-140]] dosen't take long to check the Blue lockers/White cabinets and moves to the next room quickly.
*You can anger '''D-5i''' with 4-6 shots using Perfectionist, so use it as your advantage...? ('''D-5i''' still survivable even angered. Duh)
*Other entities can still atack while '''D-5i''' is present.
**So don't open any doors while he is attacking even if you are speedrunning or you want to rush
*'''D-5i''' can't snipe. Use this to your advantage

==Trivia==
*If you're wondering, no, '''D-5i''' does NOT disable [[Claustrophobia]] (you wouldn't have enough health to survive until [[Claustrophobia]] attacks while '''D-5i''' is active, but i've already tested it).
*'''D-5i'''<nowiki/>'s line of sight is infinite, just like [[D-5]]<nowiki/>'s.

== Lore ==
'''D-5i''' is a result of a failed shadow infection, and [[Overseer]] might try to fully infect him.
